description: Tracés des lignes de transport en commun d'Île-de-France (source GTFS) is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Liste et tracés des lignes de transport en commun tirées du GTFS. Une documentation spécifique est disponible sur les données du GTFS. Elle permet de mieux appréhender les données GTFS, leur structure, les concepts métiers et les éventuelles précautions d'usage. Consulter la documentation sur les données Ile-de-France Mobilités. Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Déplacements - transports. Its keywords are Train, Métro, RER, Tramway, Bus, GTFS. The portal shows 2,025 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODbL Version Française (https://doc.transport.data.gouv.fr/le-point-d-acces-national/cadre-juridique/conditions-dutilisation-des-donnees/licence-odbl). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
